panels.title: Akış 1 · Son 10 dakikada titreşimi 1,0'ı aşan sensörler

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sensor_id AS "sensör", bolge AS "bölge", anomali AS "anomali (kayıt)", round(max_titresim::numeric, 3) AS "en yüksek titreşim", son_varis AS "son olay"
FROM anomali_son10dk ORDER BY anomali DESC

panels.title: Akış 2 · Susan sensörler (60 sn'dir olayı ulaşmayan)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sensor_id AS "sensör", bolge AS "bölge", model, son_varis AS "son olay",
  extract(epoch FROM sessizlik)::int AS "sessizlik (sn)"
FROM susan_sensorler ORDER BY sessizlik DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Dakika başına olay ve anomali sayısı

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', pencere_baslangic) AS time,
  sum(olay_sayisi) AS olay, sum(anomali_sayisi) AS anomali
FROM sensor_dakika WHERE $__timeFilter(pencere_baslangic)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Toplu 1 · Bölge × saat (Türkiye) ortalama sıcaklık, °C (14 gün)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bolge AS "bölge",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 0)::numeric, 1) AS "00",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 1)::numeric, 1) AS "01",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 2)::numeric, 1) AS "02",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 3)::numeric, 1) AS "03",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 4)::numeric, 1) AS "04",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 5)::numeric, 1) AS "05",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 6)::numeric, 1) AS "06",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 7)::numeric, 1) AS "07",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 8)::numeric, 1) AS "08",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 9)::numeric, 1) AS "09",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 10)::numeric, 1) AS "10",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 11)::numeric, 1) AS "11",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 12)::numeric, 1) AS "12",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 13)::numeric, 1) AS "13",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 14)::numeric, 1) AS "14",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 15)::numeric, 1) AS "15",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 16)::numeric, 1) AS "16",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 17)::numeric, 1) AS "17",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 18)::numeric, 1) AS "18",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 19)::numeric, 1) AS "19",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 20)::numeric, 1) AS "20",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 21)::numeric, 1) AS "21",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 22)::numeric, 1) AS "22",
  round(max(ort_sicaklik) FILTER (WHERE saat_tr = 23)::numeric, 1) AS "23"
FROM toplu1 GROUP BY bolge ORDER BY avg(ort_sicaklik)

panels.title: Toplu 2 · Sensör modeline göre anomali oranı (%)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model, round(100.0 * sum(anomali) / sum(gelen), 3) AS "anomali oranı (%)"
FROM toplu2 GROUP BY model ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Toplu 2 · Veri kaybı %5'i aşan sensörler (14 gün)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sensor_id AS "sensör", model, kurulum_yili AS "kurulum", gelen, beklenen,
  round(100 * kayip_orani::numeric, 1) AS "kayıp (%)"
FROM toplu2 WHERE kayip_orani > 0.05 ORDER BY kayip_orani DESC
